nom: Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid Tinted SPF 50+

avis.titre: Needs a wider range of skin tone options
avis.texte: As others have stated the orange tint in this sunscreen is strong. I do not recommend for even the moderately fair skinned person. Perhaps if i had more of a base tan it wouldve blended better. The finish of the product is nice enough but i took it off immediately because i looked ridiculous. Also the smell while it dries down is chemical and unpleasant. Will be returning asap

If you have dark orange skin you might like it. like literally orange not tan orange. For the price I was not expecting a mini version and the worst part…it leaks and gets everywhere. Even if it's upside down, right side up. it's a orange nightmare, don't get it.

This is the reminder to read reviews before ordering something new. I did not, but if I had, I would have learned how orange this product is. I went into store to try samples but none were available for this product. Really nice formula and feels really nice. However, this would not work for my skin tone.

avis.titre: Like a med/light foundation, but with spf benefits
avis.texte: Bought it on a pinch on my way to airport for a vacation and it outperformwd my expectations. The coverage is medium light because its a mineral formula and i think it has a sort if blurring effect. When i want it to look a little more radiant i mix it with a sheer glowy spf like the glow screen from supergoop and its a 100/10 for me. I do agree that it has a hint of orange tone, but you can tone it down by mixing it with the white version of the same product so the mineral spf virtue is maintained, or a diff spf to get the color right. As i get tanner well into summer the color is not as orangy on my skin. Formula feel comfortable in skin not too heavy, and reapplies comfotably without pilling

The tint is such a crazy shade of Great Pumpkin orange I fail to see how this blends in with any skin color or undertone. I can't comment on how it performs as a sunscreen because I was unwilling to go out in public with it on. Bummer
Not a problem with the product itself, it seems to be good, but way too dark, kind of orange, it does not match light skin, will have to return it

If you're a brown girl with medium deep skin, including olive undertones, this tinted sunscreen is perfect! It somehow completely disappears but still provides nice coverage. No castiness- it's completely undetectable in that sense. I wear this on days I don't feel like wearing foundation. I'll add brows, mascara, lip balm, and call it a day. I live in a super dry and cold climate so it's not as deeply moisturizing as something like Tower 28 (which I also love but is more makeup-y and is only spf 30) so I like to use it over a light moisturizer in the winter, unlike Tower 28 which I'd wear by itself. I wear this alone in warmer months though. Both are good if you have eczema and try to stick to mineral sunscreens which we all know often suck. It's so great to finally have a great mineral spf 50 option as a brown girl with dry skin!!

avis.titre: A look only a Cheeto could love :(
avis.texte: I bought this product solely on the fact that Yuka gave it a good review (73/100). It's so hard to find clean products at Ulta that aren't trying to do me and the earth dirty. Regardless of that, I do like the feel of the product; it finishes silky smooth. However, if they're trying to convince me that this "natural finish" is anywhere close to anyone's real complexion - we must all be Oompa Loompas.

I have always used Avene for every part of my body. I loved the old formula. This one caused allergic reaction on my eyelids. Also the old tube was bigger volume. So it is worse formula less lotion for the old price. Not cool avene not cool

avis.titre: I would not buy this again
avis.texte: The color is very orange. Didn't blend in to my fair complexion.
Its nice to have a tinted sunscreen with such high spf. Although the smell and color could definitely be improved i like this better than the cerave one.
This made me look so orange. I loved the coverage, the melting into my skin and the formula. But it turning me orange made me reture the product. Dont reccommend.

avis.titre: Similar to Bobbi Brown skin tint but make it orange
avis.texte: I reallt wanted to love this. It reminds me of Bobbi Brown skin tint. Went on smooth and blended well. An hour later I was orange. Super disappointed. Also, theres no way this has SPF. Its just a waste of money.

This has been the best SPF I've ever used. It has THE perfect color for tan skintones. The texture is light enough where it doesn't feel heavy, but it does add some coverage. I love wearing this underneath my make up or as my makeup. I have acne prone skin and this has never caused a breakout or irritation. I love it!! Give it a try if you are in the market for a new mineral sunscreen and you have a tanner skintone.
It is an orange tint. It feels dry and doesn't spread very well. But one positive is that it doesn't irritate sensitive skin.

I don't know why they changed the formula. The old one had the BEST color. I wore it every single day. This is a horrible orange color and not the same texture. I'm VERY disappointed. I will have to find a different brand.
Gives a beach vibe 😎 the texture is so lightweight, yet with noticeable coverage. I like to use this for nights out with friends for a noticeable glow

Avène's Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid Tinted SPF 50 is a great option for sensitive skin, offering 100% mineral UVA/UVB protection along with defense against blue light and pollution. Enriched with soothing Thermal Spring Water and antioxidants, this lightweight, non-greasy fluid has a universal tint and matte finish to avoid white cast. (Side note, for my dark skinned girlies. Using a little less will help. Because of skin tone, there may be a cast if you use generously) While the tint's coverage and true universality remain to be seen, it's a compelling choice for those prioritizing gentle, comprehensive sun and environmental protection.

avis.titre: excellent quality meets what is described
avis.texte: Packaging, color, smell, and texture are excellent. I really liked this sunscreen. It is easy to apply, leaves no residue, and the ingredients are good for the skin. They protect my skin from damage. It is long-lasting, and I can carry it with me. It comes in a small bottle. I am really satisfied.
I feel like this product is hard to apply. I had to use a moisturizer to get it to go on smoothly. After that though it worked great and still had some slight tint to it.
Loving this sunscreen! The tint it perfect for my face and rubs in well. It's has a smooth texture to it and provides great coverage. Average sunscreen smell to it. Would recommend!

avis.titre: Don't waste your money- orange, greasy, doesn't se
avis.texte: Unfortunately, this tinted facial sunscreen has too many negatives for my needs and I'm not sure it would work for anyone else. I was sent the "sheer" version to try as well. You'll see some side by side comparisons. The product is very runny and needs a good shake. It claims to be fragrance free and this seems accurate. The directions state to "apply generously" and to my knowledge 1/4 tsp is required for face and neck to achieve the maximum SPF rating listed on the product (50+ for this one). To apply enough for full protection it was very orange and didn't seem to absorb. It's heavy and greasy and doesn't dry down which I prefer in a facial sunscreen. I tried to run it in better hoping it would improve the way it looks, but it just rubbed off on my hands (see in one of my photos.) Even with less product from essentially rubbing off some product it still looks bad. This one was a let down all around, I have other sunscreens that are way superior. In my opinion, it needs a reformulation as it's just not good.

I used this on my face prior to going for a walk on a sunny day. It was easy to apply and the quoted 40 minute coverage seemed accurate. The texture wasn't greasy, and the product didn't really have a scent.

This product feels like a dream. It is really easy to apply and stays put all day. I was outside on a sunny day and I didn't get a sunburn on my face where I applied the product. The side of my face that didn't have the product ended up burning. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because the shade is a little too dark for me.

I love this sunscreen. I use it by mixing it with my moisturizer. It is too dark and thick to use on its own, but when mixed with my moisturizer, it become the perfect consistency and has a light coverage finish that is great for every day wear.
The smell of the Avene mineral sunscreen is amazing it doesn't leave a film or residue and it's great for sensitive skin. You have full coverage and the ingredients aren't harmful.

avis.titre: Tint is geared toward a lighter tone
avis.texte: This is a bit more of a liquid consistency but a little goes a long way. Unfortunately the tint is definitely geared to a lighter complexion because when I tried it on it gave a very white/greyish cast. I did try to rub it in too see if it would eventually blend in but I had to end up wiping most of it off, which it was ok then but I felt as if I would not be benefiting from the SPF protection because of how little I had to use to not get that cast. I feel like I would probably use this on my body if I'm out in the sun and not worried about the white cast on my skin and just for SPF purposes only but aesthetic and cosmetic wise it's a no.

The Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid Tinted SPF is very light, I think you have to get used to it a little since it is different from what we are used to, but the good thing is that this makes it very light, easily absorbed and does not leave a sticky feeling or residue on the face but without sacrificing color coverage or SPF 50 protection.

avis.titre: No white cast and goes on smoothly
avis.texte: Thanks Avene for the complimentary sunscreen in exchange for my honest review! Small but mighty, this sunscreen didn't give me any white cast and my sensitive skin tolerated it. I'm trying to use less makeup and more skincare and this is a great addition to my morning routine. I liked that it was small because you don't need much, and it's TSA size approved haha! @influenster #complimentary @aveneusa #aveneusa

Coverage is great. I'm surprised cause usually I go through so many sunscreens to find the one that works for me, lol! Avene is my favorite brand to opt in for lotions and now sunscreen, it is hydrating and moisturizing, I wear it every day and I have yet to feel sticky or it melting so so far so good! I would recommend yes!

Tinted sunscreen?? I didn't know that was a thing until I was able to give this @aveneusa a try. It is a mineral sunscreen, so it doesn't have all the bad stuff in it; and it is even smooth, not chalky. I was a little worried when I first squeezed it about how dark it was, but it evened out nicely, giving me a 'sunkissed' look to my skin. Made me feel like I was in the midst of summer, not this chilly spring day I was actually experiencing! My only negative experiences were that it felt heavy in my skin, and the tint was noticeable enough that I would have to use it everywhere to not look like I have a like from fake tanner. So color me impressed, and willing to try it again sometime!

I thought this sunscreen was really good. It had a good texture that absorbed into the skin very well and didn't leave any white cast or residual feeling. It had a slight tint to it, which allows for it to blend into your skin and make-up look easier. The scent was the typical neutral sunscreen scent but wasn't overwhelming.

avis.titre: Great tinted sunscreen for the face
avis.texte: The Avene mineral sunscreen multi defense fluid tinted spf +50 is amazing. The product goes on nice and provides just the right amount of tint. The smell is nice and I would recommend this product.

While I love most Aveeno products, this one fell flat for me. The tint was nearly orange on my skin and it had a flowery almost powder like scent. I usually wear sunscreen everyday but this product felt slick on my face and I was unable to continue using it.

I loved this sunscreen, even though it is a physical sunscreen, it does not leave that white cast on the skin and since this one has ink it is much better, it simulates a base, it is semi-dry to the touch, there is no greater production of oil, the packaging being small fits everywhere

I like it a lot but the consistency is not as smooth as I'd like. I hate to compare it to the Cerave one, but it does the job! It protects me face from the sun and it has a nice tint to cover small blemishes
Tinted version is better compared to sheer version. It doesn't leave white cast and has a glow finish. However texture is still thicker and feels heavy on my skin
I do not care for the new formula!!! Why did you change it?! It is so thick and harder to rub in compared the pervious formula. I will likely have to find a new daily sunscreen which is unfortunate.

This is a tinted sunscreen. It covers well but is thin enough to feel like nothing is on. This is unscented so it's perfect to layer if need be. It lasts awhile and is water resistant. It holds up fair to sweating but needs reapplied after a couple hours of sweating or hiking.

This is a 100% mineral sunscreen featuring zinc oxide that provides broad spectrum SPF 50+ protection. It is water resistant for up to 40 minutes and is tinted for "a natural finish for most skin tones" according to the brand. I apply sunscreen using the 3 finger method to ensure that I have full coverage and protection. Unfortunately the shade is way too warm for my light skin tone - it is super orange and looks way darker than my natural skin color. (I included a photo showing the difference between my cheek and around my ear - before completing application. The texture is quite runny, which makes it easy to apply, but it feels quite heavy on the skin. This sunscreen has nice ingredients (Niacinamide, Bisabolol, Allantoin and Tocopherol) and is safe for sensitive skin. However, I would prefer to try the non-tinted version , as I'd rather have a white cast than look like a character in Charlie & the Chocolate Factory.

I just used Avene products recently, I really like, I am trying Avene sunscreen, SPF 50 sunscreen is very suitable for the upcoming summer , The cream is easy to penetrate into the skin without causing discomfort
I love how smooth this goes on. It's not too thick. Love the amount of sun protection this provides. Its packaging, ingredients and scent are all great.

avis.titre: Great alone and no white cast
avis.texte: This sunscreen is pretty good. The color is subtle and it does blend in well. It also has light coverage and can be used alone to even out your skin and go about your day. I am an oily skin girl and this does not dry totally matte for me but it also does not leave me looking oily....it's a slight dewy finish. I like that it appears to be made with clean ingredients. It also has a SPF of 50 and is a mineral sunscreen which is great.

I like how there is a tint to this sunscreen that I don't have to worry about a white cast. Though it does run off so it would be something I would be cautious of so it doesn't run onto my clothes. Applies easy but does sit on top of the skin that's why I feel like it doesn't run onto run off easily.
Super effective sun protection and water resistant up to 40 minutes… Practically unscented… The texture is silky smooth and it's packaged in a neat but basic box…

avis.titre: Not the best for fair skin
avis.texte: I tried the Avene Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid Tinted SPF 50+, and I loved how lightweight and protective it felt on my skin. The texture was smooth, and it absorbed quickly without feeling greasy, which is a win. However, the tint was just a bit too dark for my fair skin—it gave me a noticeable orange-ish undertone that wasn't quite the natural look I was hoping for. If you're on the lighter side like me, it might not be the best match, but the formula itself is nice

I would give this 0 stars if I could. The there was no choice of shade other than tinted. It was dark and orange and only oxidized the longer it sat. It reads oomph loompa. It also started to itch after a few minutes. Complete pass. I received this product for free in return for my honest review.

I'm medium-toned, Mediterranean, slightly on the fair side regarding skin tone, I have normal/to dry/sensitive skin. I like that the SPF is lightweight, absorbs easily, and it's non-greasy. It layers well over skin care and under foundation. I didn't like the darker, warm undertone of this SPF. I tan well, with my medium Mediterranean skin type, this color was on the darker and warmer side of medium. Unless you are a solid warm undertone or darker, this SPF will not work for you. It'd be great if they made more shades, or create a neutral undertone.

I was so disappointed in this tinted sunscreen! There was no shade range for the product, so I presume that that the shade is supposed to be universal, but it was so unbelievably orange! I attempted to blend out the sunscreen so the coloring wasn't as apparent, but was unsuccessful. In addition, the sunscreen is quite thick and drying. I prefer my sunscreens to be more moisturizing. Unfortunately, I won't be repurchasing and can't recommend.

avis.titre: Make up free summer tinted spf
avis.texte: I love that this sunscreen is made for sensitive skin and the fact that it is tinted is a plus too. It can go under makeup or be worn alone which is perfect for those make up free summer days! Easy to use and packaging is nice that the tube only squeezes out a small amount at a time. I don't notice much of a scent and can't wait to see how it works as an everyday sunscreen when the weather warms up!

I was so excited to try this but very disappointed that it only comes in one tint. It's too orange for me and probably most people. It's definitely not a product that's inclusive of different skin tones.

The sunscreen is really nice. I love the packaging. The protection is great. The coverage is good. The texture is amazing. It doesn't have much sun and it doesn't leave a huge white cast so I love it.

avis.titre: Very nice color! Could pass for fountain or bb cre
avis.texte: I received this complementary product in exchange from my honest review. So first- the coloring was great! It literally looked like foundation to me! And it went on just as smoothly! I was in the sun all day at a sweaty theme park and my face stayed pretty well protected the whole day even through the sweat! I would purchase this again and use it as my foundation to protect my skin! Stop it

I would say this is lower end sunscreen/skincare. The packaging is misaligned. The cream is eeh... the color is eeh... it's just a matte basic tinted spf. I would only use this for an emergency if I ran out of my preferred brand. I would never intentionally buy this. I can say it washes off nicely and is unscented. Also, it did not bother my skin.

Great medium but buildable coverage toned sunscreen. Ribs thicker than a lot of the tinted moisturizers out there. Needed to be set on my skin type but leaves a dewy finish otherwise. The packaging is beautiful!
This is awful! Ignoring the fact that is as orange as a the fruit, it flared up my rosacea in less than a minute. 100% returning it. Save the trouble!
I thought that the tint on this product was great. It isn't greasy, it applies easily, and there is no smell. It offers 50 spf and is water resistant for 40 minutes.
Really nice! Scent wasn't overwhelming. Packaging was easy to open and easy to dispense the product. Easy to spread on my skin and lasted quite a while!
This is good. I have 2 of these and this one is great. It's very good and smooth on skin. I love it. The packaging and such is not bad either. I like this and it's great!

I did enjoy that this product didn't really have any scent/smell due to I get migraines from harsh smelling items. The color most definitely didn't match my skin and did leave it orange. As for the texture it's just like normal sun screen. It was on the thinner side.

I was really excited to try this tinted sunscreen because I wear SPF daily so adding coverage to it makes it even better! I blended it out with my fingers and it blended out beautifully! Unfortunately I'm too pale for it at the moment so I cannot wear it alone. It soaks into your skin and doesn't leave an oily finish. I ended up putting foundation over it since I can't wear it alone. I love that it's for sensitive skin as well because I breakout easily with certain sunscreens!

avis.titre: Dewy finish and good coverage, but the scent is of
avis.texte: I was excited to try this sunscreen out but ended a bit disappointed. First of all, the packaging is great, like any other sunscreen. It applies smoothly, but the first thing that stood out was the scent. I do not like the scent at all. I can even explain how it smells, but it's unpleasant. The product itself works well. The tint was a bit off, but it blended in and with the proper powder worked well. Used alone, if the color works for you, has a glow, dewy finish. I reccomend you try it out for yourself.

Some things I liked about this tinted sunscreen, nice light scent. Not oily. Had safety seal. The tint is nice, I only have been using on my face and neck. Because I don't like the cost and so saving for face only.

Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid Tinted SPF 50+ offers excellent, broad-spectrum protection in a clean formula ideal for sensitive skin. It blends effortlessly for a sheer, non-whitening finish and is water resistant—perfect for everyday use and outdoor adventures.
Only been using this 2 weeks and I've noticed a lil difference in the softness of the neck and face love the light feeling of it being on also not bad so far
I love that this is a tinted sunscreen. Has a nice light scent. The texture is light and blends in flawlessly. Perfect size package to take with you. If you have sensitive skin it's perfect for you.

Avene Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50+ is a standout product. I've found its lightweight, non-greasy formula easy to apply, making it perfect for daily use. The mineral-based ingredients provide effective SP50+ blue light protection without irritating my sensitive skin. I appreciate that it's water resistant too. At first, i noticed it has darker color than my skin, but the sunscreen absorbed quickly when I blended it and left a subtle matte finish, which is great under makeup.

This mineral sunscreen has a lightweight formula with broad-spectrum SPF 50+, offering protection against UV rays, pollution, and blue light. I appreciate that it's fragrance-free, paraben-free, and silicone-free. However, it doesn't blend well, feels greasy on my skin, and the color is too dark for me. Overall, it's not bad, but it just doesn't work for me.

I tried this mineral sunscreen by Avène for free in exchange for my honest review. I live in a desert climate, so UV protection is a high priority for me. I loved the way this sunscreen spread evenly and effortlessly. The tint was subtle and didn't leave a white cast at all. The packaging makes it very portable, it's easy to carry in your purse or even your pockets. It left a dewy and luminous finish on my skin which was very hydrating. I appreciated that this sunscreen has skin care ingredients such as niacinamide which reduces inflammation and lightens dark spots. This will be my go-to sunscreen for my face from now on.
Great sun protection, coverage, no odor, and has a smooth texture. A must have for anyone that spends anytime outdoors for protection for your face.

avis.titre: Great color and no harmful chemicals
avis.texte: Just bought my second bottle of this online. I love this product! Why? Great coverage, and I love the subtle warm golden shimmer that gives my face a sunny, healthy glow. And no, I'm sure this is not going to be the shade for every single person. So Avene, stop discontinuing good products that people like just because it doesn't suit everybody's needs. Make something else for the other people. Nothing angers customers more than when you discontinue their favorite product.

This mineral sunscreen seems like good quality. The tinted color is a bit strong so a little goes along way. It did not feel greasy and the scent was very mild. I normally don't wear mineral sunscreens due to how thick they are. This one however had a good light consistency.

Due to a medication I'm on I'm prone to melasma. Mineral sunscreen has been the key to keeping melasma at bay and also preventing freckles from darkening. I love that it's spf 50 which provides great coverage. The tinted sunscreen was easy to apply, thick but not too thick and didn't flack off when I rubbed my skin after which is a relief as many sunscreens flake beneath makeup application.
Avène mineral sunscreen multi-defense fluid tinted spf 50+ is 100/10. I love the texture and the coverage . The scent and the packaging is also giving.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This gives my skin a nice glow, and I love that it has a 50 SPF. It's easy to apply; it doesn't feel cakey or flaky. It goes on easily. You could easily wear this by itself or with makeup; lately, I just wear it without.

avis.titre: Mineral based, high SPF, and tinted without the ch
avis.texte: The tint helps keep the skin looking even while offering high SPF protection. It is zinc based but not chalky looking. It goes on rather smoothly. There is no real scent to evaluate, good or bad. It is swimproof and sweatproof up to 40 minutes. It doesn't appear to contain gluten, but i don't see the GF symbol anywhere @influenster #complimentary @aveneusa #aveneusa

Opinion on this would differ for different skin types but for mine, combination early 30's - product was super greasy, color is wildly out of color range and still needs to be used underneath everyday make up because it gives off the same ultra shiny appearance of spf. I would rather just wear my normal spf underneath my make up because the oil in this doesn't work well with my combination skin and makes my pores feel clogged.
Usually I have problems with tinted sunscreens not being the right color for me. This one was way too warm toned for me. It did feel nice on the skin. It's just not for me.

The Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid Tinted SPF 50+ is a total game-changer for everyday sun protection. The packaging is sleek and travel-friendly, making it easy to toss in my bag for touch-ups. I love that it has no strong scent — just a light, clean feel. The texture is smooth and lightweight, blending effortlessly without feeling greasy, and the tinted coverage gives my skin a natural, even glow. With SPF 50+, it provides amazing sun protection while doubling as a perfect sheer base for no-makeup days!

Omg this is the best sunscreen for my acne prone skin. No greasy feelings and no sticky patches. I love the scent which is very light. Suitable for everyone. Packaging is very cute and very comfortable. I like the very light tint it gives to my skin, my skin feels so clean after putting it. I am a fan after using it two times. Highly recommended specifically for the acne prone skin.

I didn't care much for this product. When applying, the tint was way too dark. It came out a liquid and on my skin felt greasy and thick. It could use a moisturizing agent also because it also made my face dry. The sun protection is valid which is important to me because of the sun spots I have, I don't want anymore. This product just was not for me.

avis.titre: My favorite. Love the color and the ingredients!
avis.texte: Buying my second bottle. I was worried when they changed the formula because I liked the old formula, however this one I think I like better! It's thicker for those who don't like that you might not appreciate, but it's working for me. Also I live in a warm climate so I have color all year round, and naturally tan a golden brown, and this color is perfect. It compliments my skin tone and has a nice hint of golden Shimmer that gives me a sunny summer glow all year round. Also it checks out on Yuka to not have harmful chemicals which is another buying factor for me.

This sunscreen is perfect for sensitive skin! The formula is lightweight, non-greasy, and provides excellent sun protection while also defending against blue light. The tinted finish blends naturally, leaving no white cast. It's also water-resistant, making it great for all-day wear. A must-have for daily sun protection!

Went on vacation and I loved how this evened out my skin! It was buildable and lasted a while too. I didn't feel sticky and was just so nice on the skin ! I also love the tint to this, it didn't give me a white cast at all !

Love this 100% mineral sunscreen that is great is slightly tinted so your skin doesn't turn all white unless you really rub hard like most sunscreens. It's very lightweight and doesn't clog your pores to cause breakouts thus great for sensitive skin. It's great for daily use to protect your skin from the harsh UV. It's also waterproof so great to use at the beach or pool!

This is effective for the melasma on my upper lip and looks good on my olive skin. After researching the best sunscreen for melasma, I bought this Avène product because it contains two key features: minimum SPF 50 and blue light protection.
I have aging skin and is such a great thing to have received this. I def need to wear sunblock more on my face and I love how well this stuff feels on my skin. It blends great and smells good too.

I've been curious about tinted sunscreen, but never tried one. This product is not very thick out of the tube, but has good coverage on my skin. It was unscented, and stayed on very well when I got my face wet. Obviously, the color is too dark for my pale skin, though. I would've given this five stars if the color matched my skin tone better.
So good!!! Mineral sunscreen is so good for the skin!! With spring and summer coming up it will be used so much!! So light and soft and glowy!!!!!!

I love the Avène Mineral Sunscreen Tinted SPF 50+. It matches my skin tone perfectly and blends in easily with just a small amount. It gives a nice, subtle shine without feeling greasy, and works great under makeup. Plus, I haven't had any irritation or breakouts. Overall, it's a lightweight, effective sunscreen with a natural finish.

I like this tinted mineral sunscreen so much because it covers imperfections, it works like a foundation. It has high SPF which I'm always looking for in my products. It feels kind of heavy on skin though.

Avène mineral sunscreen offers SPF50+ blue light protection, great for sensitive skin, good for daily use, and is tinted! Has a water resistant of up to 40 minutes! Texture is silky and smooth and easily able to blend into skin . I only noticed a small scent to it and it's pleasant not over powering and doesn't smell like your typical sunscreen. Over all I'm very happy with this sunscreen!

I love a good, tinted sunscreen. This looks dark right out of the tube (I have very fair skin) but it blends so well leaving a natural glow. It's not irritating and doesn't dry my skin out. I will wear this daily.

Okay so the texture is so nice and hydrating. The pigment looks really orange at first but buffs out so nice and calm and truly is just a tint so don't be alarmed. If you're really pale this wouldn't work for you. It doesn't leave a residue on the skin and it doesn't smell funky like a sunscreen! Its bottle is cute and I like how it is perfect for travel. It's not a small bottle but it's not big an bulky either. I like it!

avis.titre: Lightweight, Natural Tint & Great for Sensitive Sk
avis.texte: The Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Tinted Fluid SPF 50+ is a great option if you want sun protection with a little extra coverage. The tint helps even out my skin tone and prevents the usual white cast that mineral sunscreens can leave. It's lightweight, non-greasy, and gentle on sensitive skin. The finish is natural—not too matte or too dewy—and it layers well under makeup. The tint is subtle, so it won't replace foundation, but it does help blur imperfections. It's also fragrance-free, which is a big plus. Overall, a great everyday sunscreen for those who want mineral protection with a touch of color!
So smooth! The texture of this product is so smooth and the coverage of moisturizer worked very well. The ingredients are clearly listed on the packaging which I appreciate.

Of the natural ingredients, the full coverage.It gives the texture is creamy and silky.Not much of a cent and the packaging is greed.S nice and small to fit in your travel bag.

This is an amazing sunscreen!! The tint is very subtle and I love the packaging. I didn't get burned. The texture is very nice and not sticky at all!
wow this sunscreen is amazing because it not only gives you protection from the sun but it looks amazing on the skin. the packaging is cute and it's ingredients are awesome

Love this convenient packaging and that this sunscreen is tinted and SPF 50! Love how it goes on and feels on my skin. The tint actually gives enough coverage for an everyday look.

Avene Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 is fantastic! It offers excellent sun protection with 100% mineral filters and soothing thermal spring water. The lightweight texture blends well without feeling greasy, and it has a subtle, pleasant scent. The sleek, travel-friendly packaging is a bonus.

avis.titre: The best sunscreen out there for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I LOVE THIS STUFF! I've been using this for the past like 3-4 months after having a bad facial dermatitis breakout. I read online that sunscreen is super important to not make the condition worse, but I always have issues with sunscreen because of my very sensitive skin, and being prone to breakouts. This sunscreen has changed the game because I DO NOT break out ever from this AND it's tinted! I always mix it with my regular moisturizer since it's more orange colored to make it more skin color! Love this stuff genuinely!!!

I received this product complimentary from Avene and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This is a tinted mineral sunscreen with SPF 50+ to protect against UVA & UVB rays, blue light, pollution, and other environmental stressors. As someone with sensitive skin, finding the right sunscreen is often a challenge. Surprisingly, this product hasn't caused any irritation, redness, or breakouts, which has been a concern for me in the past with other sunscreens. It even contains great skin care ingredients such as Allantoin, Niacinamide, and Pro-vitamin E to help calm and sooth skin. The formula is mildly scented, not greasy, and quickly absorbs into skin leaving a natural finish. I recommend using a moisturizer first, as it can settle into fine lines if skin is too dry. The box says this is tinted to be blendable with most skin tones, but sadly I think my skin is just too light right now. I look forward to continue using it over the summer after I get some sun!
Excellent sunscreen protection. Goes on easily. Leaves a whitish caste. Quite water resistant for a couple of hours in the pool. No strong sent and came packed good. Recommend!!!

As someone with sensitive skin, I appreciate the mineral-based ingredients, which haven't caused any irritation. The coverage is subtle but effective, giving a slight glow without feeling heavy. Overall, it's a fantastic product for daily sun protection and a flawless base for makeup.
